Name: Taste of Nusantara - Indonesia Cuisine
Author: SpiralFX
Description:
[color=#ff0000][b][size=5][ FEATURES ][/size]
[size=4]
[/size][/b][/color][size=4]Adds 10+ Indonesia cooking, 7+ Indonesia recipes into Stardew Valley.[/size]


[quote]﻿"[b]Why did you make this mod?"

I've made this mod because i was inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31097]Turkish Cuisine[/url] mod and there i thought "What if i make a mod that represent the cooking from my country in a form of a farming game as well?" and here we are!


"Do you plan to update this mod in the future?"

Would love to when i have more free time! (I open for suggestion on what Indonesia cooking i should add next or make some few tweaks)

"Do you plan to add this mod to Stardew Mobile?"

I'll think about it.


That's all for now, terima kasih!


- SpiralFX﻿
[/b][b]
[/b][/quote]

[size=5][b]﻿[color=#ff0000][ INSTALLATION ]

[/color][/b][/size][size=4]Requirement :

> [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
> [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
> [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10455]Stardrop[/url] [/size][size=3](Not Mandatory but highly recommended Stardew mod manager)[/size]

[size=4]Manual :
[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Extract [b]SMAPI [/b]to Stardew Valley folder.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[/size][list]
[*]Make [b]"Mods"[/b] Folder inside it and extract [b]Content Patcher[/b] and [b]my mod[/b] folders into it.
[/list][size=3]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Launch [b]StardewValleyModdingAPI.exe[/b] to run the game & the mod.[/size]
[/list]
[b]With Stardrop :

[/b][size=3]Follow the instruction on how to instal [/size][b]Stardrop[/b][size=3] on their [/size][url=https://floogen.gitbook.io/stardrop/getting-started/installing-stardrop]website[/url][size=3].[/size]

[list]
[*][size=3]Extract [b]SMAPI[/b] to Stardew Valley folder.[/size]
[*][size=3][/size]
[*][size=3]﻿Once you've installed [b]Stardrop[/b], go to [b]File > Add Mod >[/b] Select [b]Content Patcher [/b]and[b] my mod[/b].[/size]
[*][size=3][/size]
[*][size=3]After finished adding them, go to [b]File > Start SMAPI[/b] to run the game. (Alternatively, [b]press the chicken symbol on top right[/b] for shortcut entering the game)[/size]
[/list]
